design.objective: Make project management and system menus global without weakening project-scoped authorization.
users: Users with project-management permission in any accessible project

requirements.statement: Global routes hide and do not initialize project context.
acceptance: stored selection remains available for project routes

requirements.statement: Project management visibility derives from project-management permission in any accessible project.
acceptance: project:project:list in one accessible project includes /projects
other project permissions alone do not include /projects
counterexample: missing current selection hides an authorized entry
project API accepts a missing context

invariants: No JWT, API, database, or project-data changes

selected_approach.name: explicit global-route metadata
selected_approach.reason: A single route classification governs the guard and all selector placements.

alternatives.name: AppLayout path list
alternatives.rejected_because: It hides UI but still initializes project context.

components.name: AppLayout
components.responsibility: render selector only for project-scoped routes

interfaces.name: GET /api/auth/routes
interfaces.contract: response remains unchanged; /projects may be included without a current project

data_flows.output: global page without project context UI

performance: one bounded aggregate permission query during authorization refresh
compatibility: response and project API contracts unchanged
operations: no migration or deployment configuration change

assumptions.falsifier: menu catalog maps /projects to another leaf permission
